title: Wikipedia and Grokipedia: A Comparison of Human and Generative Encyclopedias
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured differences in content selection, textual rewriting, narrative structure, and evaluative framing between Wikipedia and Grokipedia. For religion, this included analyzing editing dynamics (fraction of editors) on the page for 'Jesus' and the evaluative framing (laudatory vs. conflict/controversy scores) of the article on 'Opus Dei'.
findings: The study found that the page for 'Jesus' attracted a higher fraction of editors on Wikipedia than on Grokipedia. For the article on 'Opus Dei', Grokipedia showed a slightly higher laudatory framing and a lower conflict/controversy framing compared to Wikipedia.
